wayIn.name: the threshold
wayIn.what: The way in. One sideways question picks a world to open; every world is a card in the feed below for anyone who would rather choose.

wayIn.name: the mood atlas
wayIn.gloss: how it asks, and every answer
wayIn.what: What the site is trying to work out about you, every way it has of asking, and every answer it can arrive at. Ask again here, or make it forget you.

wayIn.name: site map
wayIn.what: This page: every page of the site with a line on what it is.

worlds.name: the quiet room
worlds.what: A breath to follow, a dimmer that stays where you leave it, and nothing that needs doing.

worlds.name: the wish constellation
worlds.what: Your stars hung across the whole page as a live sky: ask it for a reading, catch a meteor, play it as a chime, set it orbiting, mint a postcard.

worlds.name: the kinetic floor
worlds.what: Heavy blocks to fling with a pointer or the arrow keys, and a gravity you can turn over.

worlds.name: the diary
worlds.what: Your stars replayed as a logbook, with entries written from where they sit.

worlds.name: the machine shop
worlds.what: All 256 elementary cellular automata, one rule at a time, with the eight bits of the rule printed underneath.

worlds.name: the echo chamber
worlds.what: Your stars as drifting echoes you can pulse and listen to.

worlds.name: loam
worlds.what: A cutaway of soil. Plant something, water it, and watch the roots find their way round the stones.

worlds.name: the weather lab
worlds.what: Your stars as pressure systems, with a forecast you can print.

worlds.name: the word kiln
worlds.what: Put a word in the fire and a coinage comes out, with a definition and a citation that never existed.

worlds.name: the orbital weaver
worlds.what: Your stars mirrored into a slow mandala you can ripple.

worlds.name: the apocrypha desk
worlds.what: A catalogue of objects that were never real, dealt one at a time, with a drawer you keep.

worlds.name: the archive oracle
worlds.what: Spin your stars through a rune wheel, collect small omens, and forge a sigil to keep.

worlds.name: the lantern ritual
worlds.what: Your stars as lanterns you can kindle one at a time, and a reading pulled from the sky.

worlds.name: the terrarium
worlds.what: Your stars as plants in a glasshouse, with their own small weather.

edges.name: lost in space
edges.what: Served for any address this site does not have. The radio on it still works.

edges.name: sitemap.xml
edges.what: The same list, machine-readable, with relative locations so it holds under any sub-path.
